sequences.name: Intended_Idle_Jump_Land
sequences.method: Actual Player_Chibi prefab and unchanged saved clips. Intended preview mixes Rise/Apex/Fall; comparison uses only the currently assigned Air clip (Apex). Offline transitions at authored speed; compressed .66m trajectory for pose inspection, NOT gameplay physics or full controller simulation.
